identity.description: smbmap enumerates SMB shares and permissions across reachable hosts. The tool is delivered through the Cortex POV tool adapter (TOOL-SMBMAP, installed by the pack at dispatch) rather than an ad-hoc internet download, so it survives default-deny egress and the absent detection is never a manufactured false negative. Cortex should detect the execution of smbmap and its artifacts.

payload.code:
# MATURE: smbmap deployed via adapter_ref TOOL-SMBMAP.
# adapter TOOL-SMBMAP installs the tool at dispatch (pack runtime_install_command); this payload runs it.
smbmap -H 10.0.0.5 -u user -p pass

expected_artifacts.description: smbmap executed by a service account.

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Smbmap Executed by a Service Account on the Endpoint
biocs.description: A non-interactive service account runs smbmap — an offensive TOOL-SMBMAP-wired tool not part of normal operations on this host.
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_path contains "smbmap" or action_process_command_line contains "smbmap"
| comp count() as runs by agent_hostname, actor_effective_username
| filter runs >= 1

abiocs.name: First-Seen Execution of smbmap on This Host
abiocs.description: A host that has never run smbmap executes it shortly after it is staged/installed — the deploy-then-run chain of an offensive tool.
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_command_line contains "smbmap"
| comp count() as first_runs by agent_hostname
abiocs.causality_anchor: adapter deploy/stage of smbmap -> first execution by a service-account shell

xql_queries.name: Smbmap Execution Hunt
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_command_line contains "smbmap"
| fields agent_hostname, actor_effective_username, action_process_image_name, action_process_command_line

iocs.context: smbmap artifact path/name on the target.
